findings.summary: Focused proof omits registered failure-path coverage required by the task packet.
findings.details: The plan explicitly requires failure-first tests for forged/replayed/expired link token, wrong team/user, display-name/email match, already-bound identity, revoked WorkOS user/membership, stale connection generation, and token logging. The registered Confect test only proves one happy create/consume/replay/revoke flow against durable rows; expired, wrong-team, already-bound, revoked membership/user, stale generation, and forged-token behavior remain covered only by pure helper calls or not covered at all. This leaves the actual typed API's declared failures and authorization/fencing regressions false-green for downstream Slack intake.
